LanguageData.HE_Start_Pars.label: Heirs of Pars
LanguageData.HE_Start_Pars.description: Five Parsian settlers found a new post station on the edge of the known roads. They start with the Parsian heritage, an immortal's spear, a recurve bow, a Parsian carpet, silver and the satrapy's book of roads.
LanguageData.HE_Start_Pars.scenario.summary: Five Parsian settlers found a new post station. Parsian heritage.
